# Name Services
> Domain registration and web hosting services with account management, support, and product information.

Name Services provides domain-related services, hosting products, customer account access, and support resources for managing online presence.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://www.name-services.com/): Overview of domain, hosting, and online service offerings.
- [About Us](https://www.name-services.com/about-us): Company background and information about Name Services.
- [Contact Us](https://www.name-services.com/contact-us): Contact details and ways to reach the company.
- [Support](https://www.name-services.com/support): Entry point for customer help and service assistance.

## Domains
- [Domain Names](https://www.name-services.com/domain-names): Information about registering and managing domain names.
- [Domain Transfer](https://www.name-services.com/domain-transfer): Details on moving a domain to Name Services.
- [WHOIS Lookup](https://www.name-services.com/whois): Domain lookup and registration information search.
- [Domain Privacy](https://www.name-services.com/domain-privacy): Information on protecting registrant details with privacy services.

## Hosting
- [Web Hosting](https://www.name-services.com/web-hosting): Shared hosting plans and website hosting features.
- [Email Hosting](https://www.name-services.com/email-hosting): Hosted email services for custom domain addresses.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.name-services.com/ssl-certificates): Certificate options for securing websites and connections.
- [Website Builder](https://www.name-services.com/website-builder): Tools for creating and publishing websites online.

## Account
- [Client Login](https://www.name-services.com/client-login): Access customer account management and service settings.
- [My Account](https://www.name-services.com/my-account): Manage domains, hosting, billing, and account details.
- [Billing](https://www.name-services.com/billing): Billing information and payment-related account management.
- [Renewals](https://www.name-services.com/renewals): Renew domains and services to maintain active subscriptions.

## Support Resources
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.name-services.com/knowledge-base): Help articles and answers to common service questions.
- [FAQ](https://www.name-services.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about products and account management.
- [Submit a Ticket](https://www.name-services.com/support/ticket): Contact support for technical or account-related issues.
- [Service Status](https://www.name-services.com/status): Current operational status for hosted services and systems.

## Policies
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.name-services.com/terms-and-conditions): Legal terms governing use of services and website.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.name-services.com/privacy-policy): Details on data collection, use, and privacy practices.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.name-services.com/cookie-policy): Information about cookie usage and tracking technologies.
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://www.name-services.com/acceptable-use-policy): Rules for proper use of hosted services and accounts.

## Company Information
- [Careers](https://www.name-services.com/careers): Employment opportunities and company hiring information.
- [News](https://www.name-services.com/news): Company announcements and service-related updates.
- [Blog](https://www.name-services.com/blog): Articles, tips, and updates about domains and hosting.
- [Partners](https://www.name-services.com/partners): Information for affiliates, resellers, or business partners.
